CNES-CSG intends to renew the system called CAMDEC (Video cameras for customers) that allows filming permanently a satellite during its preparation and integration phase, in clean rooms.

CNES has several video facilities that allow to its customers permanently filming their satellite when it is in the cleanroom during preparation phase before its integration in the launcher. This System, called CAMDEC (Camera for the customers) is made of cameras and monitors screens.

CNES wants to renew this system in the aim to:
-	Improve camera resolution
-	Make the system fully remote controlled
-	Add new functionalities : image recording, qualification for images with sensible data

Inputs will consist in a requirement specification or a technical specification

Delivery will consist in the new Camdec system, qualified for operations and use of sensible data
